in_sanskrit.name: Punitha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Purity, Perfection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Punitha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Punya', meaning 'merit' or 'virtue'. The name Punitha signifies purity and perfection. It is a name given to girls born into families that are considered to be pure and virtuous. The name is also associated with good fortune and prosperity.
